learning_outcomes.text: Will be able to define the concept of quality.
Will be able to list the necessary methods to implement total quality management within the enterprise.
Will be able to apply appropriate methods and techniques to ensure quality.
Will be able to perform the necessary process analysis to establish a quality philosophy within the enterprise.

syllabus_topics: Total Quality Approach in Quality Management: Achieving Organizational Excellence
Relationship between ISO 9000 and Total Quality
Optimization and Control of Processes through Statistical Process Control
Optimization and Control of Processes through Statistical Process Control
Continuous Improvement Methods with Six Sigma, Lean Six Sigma and More
assessment_rules: The final exam constitutes 100% of the grade. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
bibliography: David L. Goetsch, Stanley B. Davis (2016). Toplam Kalite Yönetimi -Örgütsel Mükemmellik İçin-/ Toplam Kaliteye Giriş. Pearson. (7.Baskı)
John S. Oakland, (2014). Total Quality Management and Operational Excellence (4. Baskı)
